text:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's EU promo we had several near-oom alerts in the euw2-dedicated pool. Not a full outage but multiple pods throttled and some requests fell back to hosted models.
ken: Saw that. Root cause looks like two things: an AZ imbalance + node group hit a soft quota for GPUs so autoscaler couldn't spin up.
ashok: Also noticed a KV cache growth pattern for long chat sessions — per-request memory climbed over ~1.2x baseline for sessions >10k tokens.
dylan: Logs snippet from the autoscaler: ```WARN autoscaler: unable to create instanceGroup euw2-g1: quotaExceeded: GPU quota 32 -> 0 available```
julie: We had forecasted ~30% uplift but traffic profile shifted to long-chat retention, which increased model memory per session. Forecasting missed the behavioral change.
maria: Immediate mitigation was to drain a few low-priority jobs and shift routing to euw1 for internal traffic; that reduced pressure. Suggest we make this a post-incident action: adjust forecasting to include session token-length distribution, not just RPS.
ken: Agree. Actionable items I'm tracking: 1) Temporary quota request to cloud (ashok), 2) Autoscaler fallback policy to prefer region-level redistribution when AZ provision fails (dylan), 3) Bump per-route soft limits for long-chat traffic (maria).
ashok: Filed quota request with cloud support this morning (case #CLD-8892). ETA 48-72h. In parallel I can add an emergency patch to allow burst allocation from our reserved pool.
dylan: I put a quick change up for an autoscaler fallback: if AZ create fails 2x in 5m, route some requests to sibling region or fallback model variant with smaller KV footprint. Will monitor canary.
julie: Cost note — fallback to hosted models increased token spend by ~18% for the surge window. We need to balance SLA vs cost for automated fallback.
maria: +1 on cost calc. Please add a column to the rollup: projected token spend vs saved latency percent.
ken: For the planning doc: we should add a metric for "session-token tail" (p95/p99 session length) and forecast GPU-hours using a token-hour model rather than pure RPS. That will capture long-chat effects.
ashok: I'll export the session-length histogram for last 90 days and send to capacity-planning. Preliminary look: p99 session tokens doubled during promo windows.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1840123456, severity: P2, owner: maria.
maria: Quick postmortem next steps: 1) Update forecast model with token-tail (owner: ken, due EOD+5), 2) Implement autoscaler region-fallback (owner: dylan, due EOD+3), 3) Add KV cache alerts when per-session memory > 1.1x baseline (owner: ashok, due EOD+2), 4) Cost impact analysis (owner: julie, due EOD+4).
dylan: Will also add a small experiment to test quantized variants for long sessions to lower mem footprint — low-risk A/B.
julie: FYI ops will prep a short customer note template in case customers see degraded latency during future promos.
maria: Thanks all. Filing a retro in #incidents-docs with the data dumps and timelines. If anyone has other blockers ping me directly. :raising_hand:
ken: Adding one more: check node-alloc policy for preemptible vs reserved mix during promos — preemptibles got reclaimed more aggressively which compounded the capacity hole.
maria: Good catch. Add to backlog. We'll sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC for a 30m action triage.
ashok: Uploading histograms and autoscaler logs to the incident folder now.```
